title: Ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions
summary: We prove the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture. For every fixed pair of nonproportional affine forms, the Liouville correlation has a power-of-logarithm saving at every cutoff, with an absolute exponent. We also prove the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for ordinary averages of complex multiplicative functions of modulus at most one, under uniform nonpretentiousness of at least one original factor. This qualitative conclusion holds in fixed residue classes and for fixed nonproportional affine forms.
